page_title: PAR 1-0 NIC | Paris FC v Nice 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' The corner from Jonathan Clauss (Nice) is intercepted by the defence.
90+6' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) does not realise that he has already received a yellow card and is shocked when the referee shows him a second one!
90+5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Kevin Trapp (Paris FC) is cautioned by the referee, who shows him a yellow card.
90+3' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marshall Munetsi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).
90+2' Melvin Bard (Nice) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
90+2' Good work from Nice as they win a corner.

90+2' Gabin Bernardeau (Nice) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Nice will have a chance to score from a corner.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The ball is cleared after Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
88' A substitution has been made. Charles Vanhoutte goes off and Tanguy Ndombele (Nice) comes on.
88' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Maxime Dupe was alert and made a comfortable save.
87' The resulting set piece from Paris FC is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) controls a pass, goes past a defender and curls a shot from the edge of the box right onto the right post.
84' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
82' Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
82' Gabin Bernardeau (Nice) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
80' That's the end of the game for Moses Simon, who is replaced by Alimani Gory (Paris FC).
80' Here is a change. Jonathan Ikone is going off and Antoine Kombouare gives the last tactical orders to Nhoa Sangui (Paris FC).
78' This is a yellow card! Kail Boudache (Nice) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
78' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
77' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kevin Trapp, who smothers the ball.
74' Melvin Bard (Nice) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
73' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) will take a corner kick.
71' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) rushes a shot from long range and subsequently sends it high over the bar.
70' Moses Simon (Paris FC) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

70' What a sweet touch by Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny him! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Paris FC.
70' The substitution has been made. Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) has replaced Ciro Immobile.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rudy Matondo (Paris FC) comes onto the pitch for Ilan Kebbal.
68' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) hits a shot towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Kevin Trapp.
67' Claude Puel has decided to make a change. Tiago Gouveia (Nice) replaces Tom Louchet.
67' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sofiane Diop will be replaced by Gabin Bernardeau (Nice).
67' A player from Nice commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
66' The main referee, Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) is given a yellow card for dissent.
65' Nice seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
64' Tom Louchet (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but Kevin Trapp comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Kevin Trapp.
62' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) works the corner short.
62' Morgan Sanson (Nice) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Nice will take a corner.
61' Tom Louchet (Nice) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
60' Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
60' Now Paris FC have a corner.
59' Moses Simon (Paris FC) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
58' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
55' A pass by Sofiane Diop (Nice) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Paris FC.

54' Paris FC are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
53' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
53' Moses Simon (Paris FC) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

52' Maxime Dupe makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner. The linesman makes the right call and Paris FC will have a corner.
51' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kojo Peprah (Nice) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
48' Neat passing move from Nice in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claude Puel gives a chance to Kail Boudache and Kevin (Nice) is off.
45+2' Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Sofiane Diop (Nice) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' A pass from Tom Louchet (Nice) is intercepted by Kevin Trapp and the move breaks down.
45' A player from Paris FC commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
43' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) was quite harsh and Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) attempts to find Ciro Immobile with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
40' Juma Bah (Nice) produces a long-range pass.
40' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) heads on.
39' Moses Simon (Paris FC) escapes the opposition's pressure by passing the ball on the ground.
36' Kojo Peprah (Nice) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Kevin Trapp easily makes the save.
35' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
34' Adama Camara (Paris FC) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
34' Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
32' Corner kicks – 3:2.
31' Paris FC hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
28' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
26' 1 - 0 Goal! Maxime Dupe makes a huge mistake and Marshall Munetsi (Paris FC) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
25' Sofiane Diop (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Paris FC will have a goal kick.
24' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
22' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) has tested the patience of referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
19' Kevin (Nice) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
19' The penalty decision is reversed after referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem changes his mind following the VAR review into the infringement.
18' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Nice as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
18' Kevin (Nice) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
17' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) makes a slide tackle, but referee Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem blows for a foul. The referee gives a penalty to Nice!
17' Nice hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Paris FC.

13' Ciro Immobile (Paris FC) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the roof of the net, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save. Paris FC force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
9' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
8' Pierre Lees-Melou (Paris FC) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
8' The corner is swung in but Paris FC can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
8' A pass by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
5' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

5' Jonathan Ikone (Paris FC) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Paris FC.
5' Diego Coppola (Paris FC) attempts to find his teammate with a lofted through pass.
3' Tom Louchet (Nice) receives a lofted pass from the flank and shoots from close range, but the ball flies slightly wide, almost brushing the left-hand post.
2' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Paris FC will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
